title: Approval.
officialText:
Faucets and fixture fittings shall conform to ASME A112.18.1 or CSA B125. Faucets and fixture fittings that
supply drinking water for human ingestion shall conform to the requirements of NSF 61, section 9. Flexible water connectors
exposed to continuous pressure shall conform to the requirements of Section 605.6.
